_comment: the Tungaamal gold answers for INFLECTED forms. GENERATED by scripts/import-harvest.mjs — do not edit by hand. These are deliberately NOT in the lexicon: storing an inflected form as a stem inflates coverage and hides the fact that the pipeline could not have derived it. Held out here, they measure segment + resolve + generate end to end. `detached` means Tungaamal wrote the suffix after a connector, so the chain is readable; when false it wrote it attached.
